What is a Document Portal and Why Do You Need One?

A document portal is a centralized platform where you can store, share, and manage documents and information related to your wedding coordination business. With a document portal, you can keep track of contracts, invoices, timelines, and other important documents in one place. This not only helps you stay organized but also ensures that you can access the information you need quickly and efficiently.

Using Base44 to build a document portal can help you save time and reduce errors. With its AI-powered no-code app builder, you can create a customized portal without requiring any coding knowledge. This means you can focus on what you do best – planning and coordinating beautiful weddings.
